About Plane
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.
Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.
Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.
Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
Humans and agents
We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.
Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.
This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

Plane has over a million users, and Fortune 500 companies deploying Plane. Enterprises in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance are running Plane in production — some in air-gapped, classified environments. The commercial demand is real and growing. This role exists to own it.
You'll run full-cycle enterprise deals from first conversation to signed contract. You'll work directly with the CEO and the product team, because at this stage, a deal isn't just a sales process — it's a product feedback loop. You'll sell into technical buyers who already know the product, navigate complex procurement in regulated industries, and help build the playbook as you go.
Plane's sales motion is product-led. The funnel doesn't start with cold outreach — it starts with teams already using Plane and hitting a ceiling where they need enterprise capabilities: compliance, SSO, air-gapped deployment, priority support. Your job is to convert that organic interest into expanding enterprise revenue.

Run deals end-to-end — from first enterprise inquiry to signed contract. You own the entire arc: discovery, demo, technical evaluation, security review, procurement, negotiation, close. Full-cycle means full ownership.
Convert product-led interest into enterprise revenue — Plane's funnel doesn't start with outbound. It starts with someone self-hosting Plane, hitting a scale or compliance ceiling, and raising their hand. Your job is to recognize those signals, engage at the right moment, and guide the conversation from "we're evaluating" to "we're deploying."
Navigate complex enterprise procurement — our buyers sit in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance. That means security questionnaires, compliance reviews, legal redlines, multi-stakeholder approval chains, and timelines measured in months, not days. You need to know how to move a deal through that machinery without losing momentum.
Hold technical credibility in the room — you'll be talking to VPs of Engineering, DevOps leads, and IT architects about self-hosted deployments, air-gapped environments, SSO configurations, and data residency requirements. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own in these conversations and know when to bring one in.
Build and refine the sales playbook — document what works. Which objections come up repeatedly? What's the typical deal cycle? Where do deals stall? What collateral is missing? You're not just selling — you're creating the system that the next 3-5 AEs will run on.
Feed product with deal intelligence — every deal you run generates signal about what the market wants, what competitors are doing, and where Plane has gaps. You bring that signal back to the product team in a structured, actionable way — not as a feature request list, but as a pattern.

You've closed enterprise software deals in the $500K–$1M ACV range, running the full cycle yourself — not inheriting qualified pipeline from a BDR team or handing off to a solutions engineer for the technical conversation.
You've sold into technical buyers — engineering leadership, DevOps, IT — and you can have a real conversation about deployment models, infrastructure, and security without reading from a script. You understand the difference between selling to someone who writes code
and selling to someone who writes checks.
You've worked at an early-stage company (Series A or earlier) where the sales infrastructure didn't exist yet. You've built your own pipeline, written your own sequences, created your own collateral, and figured out the motion before it was documented.
You understand product-led growth and know how to work with it rather than against it. You don't fight the free tier — you see it as the top of your funnel and know how to identify when a user is ready for an enterprise conversation.
You're comfortable with long deal cycles and multi-stakeholder procurement processes. You don't get rattled when a deal takes 4 months and involves legal, security, compliance, and IT all having veto power.
You're structured in how you manage your pipeline, your notes, and your follow-ups. Not because someone made you use a CRM, but because you've learned that rigor is what separates someone who closes from someone who's "always about to close."
You can write. Not marketing copy — clear, concise follow-up emails, proposals that address the buyer's actual concerns, and internal summaries that help the team understand what the market is telling you.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.
As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Enterprise Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne or Frankfurt.
What you'll be doing
In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
Our humble expectations
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in English and German.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.
You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.
You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.
Next steps
If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.
After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.
Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Buffalo/Rochester NY

We will leverage the strength of all Cloudflare functions to become a strategic partner to our customers and their digital transformation efforts. Our product and services and our methods of engagement will differentiate and delight our customers.
The AE will interact with both C-level clients and senior technical decision makers, utilizing Cloudflare solutions and resources to drive a business partnership focused on joint success with our customers.

Success requires consultative, solutions-oriented sales, and customer service skills in addition to intense personal energy and focused activity.

A critical factor of achievement in this role is the ability and desire to focus and lead an internal group of constituents to bring their skillset to bear to build solutions and exponentially grow revenue.

The AE must be expert in identifying business opportunities with customers, developing Enterprise Account Plans, driving execution across functional stakeholders, and closing revenue.

The Enterprise Account Executive should be comfortable engaging in business level outcome conversations with the C-suite, presenting Cloudflare’s vision and plan for value creation to all levels, and negotiating win-win scenarios for all parties.

The AE will be accountable to obtaining new business and expansion of Cloudflare wallet-share within existing customers. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources.

Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.

Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Have a plan for “how” you’ll hit your goals and evaluate often; that way you always know where you stand. Be in a position and ready to demonstrate your plan for success.
Provide Customers with a Premium Business Experience - Solutions, Empathy, Proactiveness, Anticipation of needs, Company Support, Creativity, and Urgency to Deliver Value are core principles of a Cloudflare Strategic Account Experience. Give your customers a level of service that is unmatched in the industry.
Be Brilliant in the Basics - The hallmark of a high performance team is their willingness to commit to Brilliance in the Basics in all aspects of their roles. Forecasting, SFDC Disciplines, Pipeline Management, Account Engagement, Negotiation, Closing, and Depth of Cloudflare Knowledge are the basic skills that make a Strategic Account Executive successful.
Make Bold Decisions - Operating with the largest companies in the world is a “game of inches”. Often the Enterprise Account Executive will have to make strategic decisions on engagement, terms, and support. These decisions should be made by the AE who is closest to the issue and most affected by it. Top down management of accounts is outdated because of the speed of today’s business. If execution presents risk, Seek the advice of leaders when and where you need it.
Teammate - We are all individually accountable to our goals, but we operate as a team. No one person has all the answers, but collectively the knowledge, experience, and acumen of the team is deep. Be the person who actively seeks to assist the team, shares knowledge, and extends your personal network. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.
Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.
Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.
Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.
Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.
Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.

Organize and deliver executive level presentations, proposals, commercial terms with Customers.
Leverage the Executive Briefing Center and process to establish key sponsorships and support of accounts with Cloudflare Executives.
Build and maintain relationships with channel partners to establish joint value propositions and Customer value.
Participate in team meetings and deliver GTM guidance on how to better partner with accounts.

Health can’t wait .
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Do you want to move past transactional, inbound-dependent selling to open major accounts from scratch, taking full ownership of the sales narrative for an early-stage product where technical credibility and strategic context matter?
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Enterprise software sales requires deep technical curiosity and real ownership, especially when introducing a completely new product category. AppGlass is our new AI-powered production debugging product designed to help engineering teams investigate complex issues directly within running applications. Because this is an early-stage product, we are building our enterprise pipeline from the ground up, moving past inherited inbound funnels to establish direct relationships with engineering leaders.
In this role, you will lead the full outbound enterprise sales execution for AppGlass across Europe. You will work independently to self-source opportunities, map complex organization structures, and gain access to senior technical decision-makers.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Lead to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), funnel strategy, and product messaging based on real-world interactions.

You will own the entire commercial relationship – from initial discovery through security, procurement, and contract execution – directly influencing how our product scales in the global enterprise market.

Identify and reach relevant engineering decision-makers within target enterprise accounts.
Source your own sales pipeline through professional networking, targeted outreach, referrals, and industry events.
Lead comprehensive discovery sessions and commercial conversations with technical champions and economic buyers.
Drive enterprise pilot programs forward, ensuring clear alignment between user feedback and commercial goals.
Navigate complex security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement cycles, and vendor onboarding processes.
Negotiate and finalize B2B commercial agreements to secure new enterprise customers.
Deliver structured feedback from prospects to product teams to help continuously refine positioning and features.

A problem-solving mindset that enjoys turning early-stage product complexity into clear, structured business value.
The autonomy to drive enterprise deals independently and take full accountability for the revenue outcomes.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical engineering concepts intelligently with developers and financial realities with executives.
A commitment to building long-term trust with clients over securing quick, transactional wins.
Resilience and adaptability when navigating the ambiguous, evolving landscape of a new product launch.
What you’ll need
A proven track record of closing enterprise B2B sales for highly technical products, such as developer tools, observability, infrastructure, cloud, or security software.
The demonstrated capability to open major enterprise accounts from zero without relying on pre-existing inbound leads.
An established professional network among engineering leaders and senior technology executives.
Hands-on experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal frameworks, compliance hurdles, and information security evaluations.
Strong command of strategic outbound pipeline generation methodologies.
Fluency in written and spoken English for daily collaboration across international teams and client organizations.
What success looks like
Success means establishing predictable, scalable enterprise sales for AppGlass. You will earn the trust of the team by consistently securing qualified meetings with enterprise decision-makers and turning raw outreach into active, progressing pilot programs. You win when you navigate complex security and procurement hurdles smoothly, converting early-stage pilots into stable, long-term paid commercial agreements that validate our market positioning and drive sustainable revenue growth.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Business Development Manager, APAC (China Clients)
EBANX is looking for a Business Development Manager to drive net-new merchant acquisition across the China commercial organization, with a focus on China-headquartered companies expanding into Latin America, Southeast Asia, Middle East & Africa, India and other growth markets that Ebanx is about to operate.

This is a pure hunter role — you will be responsible for opening doors, building pipeline from scratch, and closing first contracts with strategic and enterprise-tier merchants across high-priority verticals.
The China BD pipeline is growing fast, but the next wave of growth depends on new deals opened today. You will be the engine of that next wave. To succeed here, you need the ability to identify the right account, map complex internal stakeholder structures across merchant organizations, and close deals that span multiple countries and product lines simultaneously.

Build and manage a net-new merchant pipeline across target verticals — Gaming, Online Retail, Mobility, SaaS, Streaming, and Entertainment — with a focus on accounts that have a clear multi-market expansion thesis.
Prospect, qualify, and advance deals from first contact through signed contract, with rigorous stage discipline tracked in Salesforce.
Navigate multi-stakeholder merchant structures: many target accounts (e.g. Chinese companies expanding into LATAM) require parallel engagement with China HQ, regional business teams, local legal/finance, and treasury — you will map and manage all of them.
Own deal strategy for complex, multi-country opportunities, including phased go-live approaches (e.g. launching Argentina first while tax assessments clear in CL/CO/PE), and work cross-functionally with EBANX Legal, Tax, Compliance, and Product to unblock deals.
Develop territory and vertical strategies identifying where EBANX has the strongest competitive angle and where stronger pipeline coverage is still needed — particularly in MEA, SEA, and India.
Collaborate with Ebanx country and regional teams to facilitate introductions between merchant China headquarters and local subsidiary stakeholders that BD cannot access directly.
Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting in Salesforce, including honest probability assessments and clear next actions for each deal stage.
Collaborate closely with the internal Key Account Management team to have warm hand-overs for accounts that need to be transferred after the initial period, with a full deal brief, relationship map, and activation plan — and monitor post-signing go-live to ensure committed GP materializes.

Mandarin as a native language; fluent English.
7+ years in business development or new logo sales, with a demonstrated track record of closing net-new enterprise accounts — not just managing existing portfolios.
Deep knowledge of the payments landscape: processing flows, card schemes, local alternative payment methods, chargeback and fraud dynamics, and how these differ across LATAM, SEA, MEA, and India.
Proven experience managing deals with long, complex cycles — multi-department merchant approvals, multi-country tax and regulatory assessments, and incumbent displacement situations.
Comfortable working independently on greenfield accounts: you can build a relationship from zero, develop a commercial thesis, and drive to close without a warm handoff.
Strong analytical mindset: you use data to prioritize your pipeline, build a business case, and challenge assumptions — internally and externally.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field.
Overseas living or working experience strongly preferred — comfort navigating cross-cultural and cross-timezone commercial dynamics is essential.
Flexible working hour to accommodate China, LATAM, SEA, and MEA time zone overlap.

s.h: What we're looking for beyond the resume
s.t:
Hunter mentality with strategic depth. You are energized by opening new accounts and building pipeline from scratch. But you also understand that the biggest deals — multi-country, multi-year — require a thoughtful, multi-stakeholder strategy, not just activity volume. You know when to push and when to play a longer game.
Ability to drive deals through blockers, such as legal bandwidth, KYM friction, multi-department business case review loops, and taxation assessments across markets. You have encountered these before, and you know how to unstick them — either by escalating internally or by restructuring the commercial approach.
Geographic range and regional curiosity. LATAM is the core market, but the next phase of Ebanx BD growth runs through new Growth markets like MEA, SEA, and India. You are genuinely curious about these markets, can build a thesis for why a specific merchant should expand there, and are comfortable prospecting in regions where EBANX is less established.
Vertical credibility in at least two of: Gaming, Online Retail, Mobility, SaaS, Streaming, or Entertainment. You understand the business model, unit economics, seasonal dynamics, and payment complexity specific to those verticals — and can translate that into a relevant commercial pitch.
Resilience and composure in ambiguity. Deals stall. Merchants deprioritize markets. Tax assessments take longer than expected. You stay productive under uncertainty and know how to maintain momentum without losing the relationship.
Pipeline discipline. You treat Salesforce as a source of truth, not a formality. Your stage assessments are honest, your next actions are specific, and your forecasts reflect reality.
Ownership through activation. You don't consider a deal done at contract signing. You track post-signing integration timelines and volume migration, and escalate proactively if a signed account isn't converting — because committed GP that doesn't activate is a miss.
Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;

About Andercore
Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.
We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing.

For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover
Seven European markets live
80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai
$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

About IntelliShift
IntelliShift is a fleet intelligence platform on a mission to create a safer, smarter tomorrow for the fleets that move the world. We bring telematics, AI dash cams, maintenance, compliance, and safety together in one connected platform — built for fleet people, by fleet people. And we’re always thinking about what comes next.

This is a new business role built for hunters. You’ll target the sweet spot of our market: high-value fleet accounts where deal sizes are substantial, complexity varies, and the growth opportunity is massive. You’ll chase $100K+ ARR opportunities, win competitive cycles, and build a book of business you’re proud of.
You’ll run the full cycle and own your territory end to end, working with a dedicated Account Development Rep (ADR) and with Marketing to reach fleet operators across transportation, food and beverage delivery, utilities, field service, and more. This role sits on our New Business Sales team, reporting to our VP of Sales.

Own your territory. Run full-cycle sales end to end — strategic outbound, multi-stakeholder discovery, and executive-level close — targeting fleet operators across transportation, food and beverage delivery, utilities, field service, and more.
Build to win. Develop relationships with the decision-makers, operations leaders, and safety executives who actually move deals forward.
Co-sell smart. Partner with your dedicated ADR on territory strategy and pipeline. They’re a resource, not a relay.
Know your customer. Research each prospect’s business goals, operational challenges, and fleet pain points before you ever ask for a meeting.
Forecast with conviction. Give leadership accurate, timely pipeline and forecast data. No sandbagging, no surprises.
Go to market. Execute sales plans, field events, and campaigns with precision, and use your industry presence and social channels to expand your reach in target verticals.
Move the platform forward. Work with Marketing on collateral and value messaging that reflects what’s actually resonating in the field.
Hit the number. Deliver consistently against quarterly ARR targets, with a focus on high-value, multi-year contracts.

Must-haves
Several years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of hitting or beating quota — ideally in new business.
Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals at the $100K+ ARR level, or comparable.
Strong outbound and prospecting skills — you build pipeline, you don’t wait for it.
Comfort selling to operations, safety, and executive buyers with a consultative, value-based approach.
Disciplined pipeline and forecasting habits, and clear, confident communication.
Nice-to-haves
Experience in fleet, telematics, video safety, or another hardware-attached SaaS category.
Experience selling into transportation, food and beverage, utilities, or field service.
Experience working with an ADR or SDR in a co-sell motion.
The Values You’ll Live By
Our five core values aren’t posters on a wall — they show up in how we work every day. In this role, that looks like:
Customer-Obsessed — You keep customers at the center of your decisions, because when they win, we win.
No-Box Innovation — You bring bold ideas and help build what hasn’t been built before.
Growth through Friction — You treat friction as a signal, challenge what’s inefficient, and push for something better.
Trust through Action — You lead with transparency and let your follow-through do the talking.
Own It — You take accountability for outcomes and make a positive difference wherever you can.
How We Measure Success
New business ARR. Consistent delivery against your quarterly quota, with a focus on high-value, multi-year contracts.
A strong pipeline. A healthy, well-qualified pipeline you build through outbound and smart territory planning.
Competitive wins. A solid win rate in competitive cycles.
Reliable forecasting. Accurate, on-time forecasts leadership can count on.

We’re a company that bought itself back and bet on its own future. That means the work here is real, decisions move fast, and the people who own outcomes get to shape what comes next. You’ll work alongside fleet experts who genuinely care about the customers we serve, in a place where good ideas win no matter where they come from.
A large, underpenetrated market and real room to build a book of business.
A dedicated ADR and a marketing team invested in your territory’s success.
Real commission upside and the autonomy to run your territory your way.

We offer competitive compensation, commensurate with experience: $115,000–$130,000 base, plus commission. We also offer outstanding benefits to simplify the lives of our employees and show them how much we appreciate their contributions. IntelliShift provides a full benefits package including company-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a 401K with a 4% company contribution.
Equal Opportunity
IntelliShift is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Censys ’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.
Censys has emerged as a leader in internet-scale attack surface management — and we're scaling the sales org to match. This is your shot to own the New York Metro Territory at exactly the moment a Series D, category-defining security company needs its next great territory builder.

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.h: In your first month, you will
s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
Compensation: 150,000 to 190,000 USD on-target earnings (60% base, 40% variable), with guaranteed variable during ramp.
US-based, remote, near a major hub airport.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

At Sodexo, our Energy & Resources segment serves four markets: Mining, Offshore & Marine, Onshore Energy, and Engineering & Construction Projects.

Our growing team of employees is dedicated to improving productivity, building meaningful client relationships, reducing on-site problems and improving quality of life for the thousands of Australians who call our remote sites home.
Why choose Sodexo?
Sodexo is a people business, employing over half a million people worldwide and thousands here in Australia. Our employees, who personify Sodexo's unique values of Service Spirit, Team Spirit and Spirit of Progress, are our greatest asset through their commitment and dedication.
We believe the more diverse we are, the stronger we are. No matter your background, we will do all we can to help you thrive. We are committed to promoting equal opportunities, valuing diversity, and creating an inclusive working environment for all our employees.
At Sodexo, we are a proud Equal Opportunity Employer and encourage applications from all applicants regardless of age, race, sex, ethnicity, religion and beliefs and people with disabilities.
We offer a competitive salary, many development opportunities and an outstanding benefits and recognition program!

If you are interested in joining the Sodexo team and meet the minimum criteria outlined above, please apply with your resume detailing relevant employment experience  and availability.

Submit your application today and become part of the Sodexo family!

The role of Operational Account Manager (Energy Codes) sits within Talan UK's Future Markets function and is part of the Stakeholder Engagement team.
Energy Codes are at the heart of the regulation of the GB energy market, setting the standards for new and improved ways of working. Covering the complete breadth of the market, Code Reform has introduced a new model of cooperation and best practice for Code Management and delivered a new digital, modern, and accessible, consumer-centric code.
Our team of Operational Account Managers is integral to the onboarding and socialisation of these arrangements. The team is responsible for working with Parties to the Codes, and other key stakeholders. They have a primary role, providing named support to multiple parties and stakeholders.

They understand differing party types and individual company needs and recognise where parties may be impacted by changes to the Codes and the way the arrangements work. They are responsible for working with Stakeholders to help them develop their understanding of the code and respective responsibilities within it.
The Operational Account Managers work with all Code Manager functions to understand the scale and impact of change and ensure parties are always informed and supported. They work across the Code Manager teams to ensure new parties are onboarded to the arrangements, and fully supported as they enter the market.

They ensure parties know how to access all elements of the code manager service and how they can provide feedback queries, and improvements to the arrangements. They need to explain the Code strategy in a language and context that is relevant to different organisations, accounting for their market role, experience, and business model.

As well as high-level plans, the Operational Account Managers are sharing information and contributing to the training and development of new parties and new personnel.
The Operational Account Managers have a key supporting role in identifying and predicting change for the market and its participants. They contribute to the strategic direction of the Codes by evaluating its future requirements and assessing the appetite for change amongst parties and categories of Party, which in turn contribute to a more balanced and equitable market.

Create and maintain close working relationships with a wide variety or party types, supporting them in engaging with all aspects of the Code and the services that it provides.
Gather and share feedback on all aspects of the Code and support continuous improvement activities.
Work closely with other Code service providers to onboard parties and stakeholders to the Code and/or Code services, ensuring a smooth journey for applicants and all SLAs are met.
Develop and maintain strong, collaborative working relationships with other Code Managers and Service Providers.
Support the Change Management team with the development of enduring change solutions and ensure that the parties you work with are aware of the changes and the opportunities they have to input to the process.
Understand the impact and scale of change required by their stakeholders and provide an initial impact assessment of change to systems, processes, and code changes.
Supporting the service desk to ensure enquiries are responded to in a timely manner, including addressing Service Desk tickets that are allocated to you for resolution.
Ensuring the team meets its service levels by working to and taking ownership of deadlines.
Drafting and reviewing internal and external documentation, including guidance, communications, and website content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Analysis of data to identify areas of concern within the arrangements and proactively engage with parties to highlight current and future areas of impact.
Draft and present agenda items to facilitate engagement and debate at industry forums.
Proactively support our Stakeholder Engagement team with projects, changes and or tasks, using your own initiative to manage workload in line with team Service Level Agreements.
Drive efficiency by identifying and leading on opportunities for continuous improvement, championing best practices alongside the wider team, as well as identifying new ways to benefit our clients.

Ability to create resilient relationships
An understanding of differing stakeholder needs and how to put Parties and Consumers at the Heart of the Service
Problem solving – taking ownership for the resolution of issues and queries raised by the Parties you work with
Be ambitious, creative, and innovative, learn lessons from their work, share expertise and continuously learn
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, able to understand and articulate complex issues to all levels of seniority and to technical and non-technical audiences.
A keen eye for detail and the highest standard of quality for themselves and others.
Passionate about delivering an exceptional service and positive outcomes for the market and consumers.
Be a team player, with strong interpersonal skills, working collaboratively towards a shared vision for the future
Upon employment, employees should also have a sound awareness of the Company's Information, Quality, Environmental and Energy Management Systems

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact.

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Snowflake
Snowflake is the world's leading AI Data Cloud company, powering the future of data and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to mobilize the world's data — breaking down silos and enabling every organization to unify, govern, and unlock the full value of their data at scale.

Built on a single, fully managed platform that is Easy, Connected, and Trusted, Snowflake empowers enterprises to run all of their data, AI, and application workloads — from advanced analytics and machine learning to generative AI and agentic applications — without moving data out of a secure, governed environment.
With thousands of customers across every major industry worldwide and a consumption-based model that scales with value delivered, Snowflake is one of the fastest-growing enterprise platforms in the cloud era. We believe that there is no AI strategy without a data strategy — and we are building the platform that makes both possible.
Account Executive Team
The Account Executive team works closely with internal cross-functional teams and partners to deliver Snowflake's value to customers and serve as trusted advisors on long-term data strategy. The Korea sales organization operates across four industry-aligned teams to drive deep vertical expertise and customer intimacy.

As part of our continued investment in Korea, we are seeking a Majors Account Executive to lead the strategic relationship with Global Electronics customer — one of the most iconic and globally significant technology and manufacturing conglomerates.

This individual will represent Snowflake across customer's diverse business divisions and serve as the single point of executive accountability for the account.
The Impact You Will Make
Champion data innovation across a global conglomerate: Lead Snowflake's data cloud strategy for the global Electronics customer, driving adoption and expansion across its diverse business divisions — including semiconductors, mobile, display, home appliances, and enterprise IT — in partnership with customers and ecosystem partners.
Become a Snowflake expert: Conduct discovery calls, deliver customised demos, and present tailored solutions to prospects and stakeholders across multiple Samsung business units.
Be the trusted advisor: Deeply understand the global Electronics customer's existing and future IT roadmap, digital transformation priorities, and industry-specific challenges to position Snowflake as a strategic platform partner.
Drive full-lifecycle sales execution: Own pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and deal closure across the global Electronics customer account — landing new use cases, expanding existing deployments, and deepening platform adoption.
Build and execute a strategic account plan: Develop and maintain a comprehensive account plan with targeted stakeholder mapping, opportunity pipeline, and quarterly/annual revenue targets. Proactively identify whitespace and cross-sell opportunities across business divisions.
Cultivate executive relationships: Build and sustain trusted relationships with CxOs, IT executives, Line-of-Business leaders, and key decision-makers across the global Electronics customer's corporate and divisional leadership.
Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration: Lead engagement across Snowflake's internal teams — including Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Finance — as well as regional and global counterparts, to deliver a seamless and unified customer experience.

Experience & Track Record
10+ years of field sales experience in the technology industry, with a strong focus on enterprise or major account management in areas such as Data Warehousing, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and/or AI/ML.
Proven track record of managing and growing a major, multi-division account (or comparable large-scale enterprise account) with demonstrated success in exceeding revenue targets and driving significant business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience in navigating complex organizational structures — engaging and delivering results across multiple business units, divisions, or subsidiaries within a single global account.
Experience in the manufacturing, technology, or electronics industry is highly preferred; existing industry relationships and domain expertise are a strong advantage.
Executive Engagement & Relationship Building
Established ability to build and maintain C-level and senior executive relationships — including CxOs, VPs of IT/Data, and Line-of-Business leaders — and to leverage these relationships to drive strategic alignment and accelerate deal velocity.
Proven capability to engage key decision-makers and influencers at the executive level, with a track record of converting executive sponsorship into long-term, enterprise-wide platform adoption.
Strategic Mindset & Growth Orientation
A growth mindset with a passion for identifying and capitalizing on new opportunities — whether expanding into new business units, introducing new use cases, or driving platform adoption in untapped areas.
Strong strategic thinking with the ability to develop and execute long-term account strategies that align Snowflake's platform capabilities with the customer's business priorities, digital transformation goals, and competitive landscape.
Expertise in value-based selling — accurately diagnosing customer challenges, mapping Snowflake solutions to business outcomes, and articulating quantifiable ROI to senior stakeholders.
Cross-Team Collaboration & Leadership
Demonstrated ability to lead and orchestrate cross-functional, cross-regional teams — including domestic (Korea) and international (HQ, APAC, global) stakeholders — to deliver coordinated account strategies and exceptional customer outcomes.
Experience working in a matrixed, global organization where success depends on influencing without authority, rallying internal resources, and maintaining alignment across time zones and cultures.
A One Team mindset — collaborative, supportive, and committed to driving collective success across Sales Engineering, Services Delivery, Product, Partners, and other internal teams.
Core Competencies
Exceptional communication and presentation skills — with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in business terms to diverse audiences, from technical architects to C-suite executives.

The Mission
The Global Revenue Enablement (GRE) organization exists to equip every audience in our ecosystem — field sellers, technical specialists, and partners — with the clarity, content, and skills they need to execute with speed and consistency. But enablement doesn't stop at the field. The fastest path to consumption is a customer who knows exactly how to use what they've bought.
That's where Customer Activation comes in.
We're building a function that embeds education directly into the account motion — not as a post-sale afterthought, but as a deliberate strategy to accelerate time-to-value, reduce friction in expansion conversations, and protect consumption in accounts that matter most.
The Customer Activation Partner for Japan & Korea will embed education into the account motion across a defined set of top accounts in both markets. This is not as a support function, but a deliberate strategy to accelerate adoption, reduce time-to-value, and surface the expansion signals that matter to the business.
You'll operate with significant autonomy, working directly with account teams, customers, and regional delivery resources to build education plans that drive measurable consumption outcomes. And you'll serve as the primary voice connecting what's happening on the ground in Japan and Korea back to the global curriculum and enablement organization.

Account Education Ownership: Build and maintain education relationships with a defined set of strategic accounts across Japan and Korea. Develop account-level learning plans in partnership with account teams and ensure customers derive measurable value from their training investments
Pre-Sales Advisory: Engage early in deal cycles where education is a differentiator or a friction point; scope and solution education packages that accelerate customer confidence and deal progression
Localization & Cultural Fit: Partner with curriculum and delivery teams to ensure training content, delivery style, and instructional framing resonate with enterprise audiences in Japan and Korea — flagging gaps proactively and advocating for market-specific adaptations
Voice of Customer: Synthesize patterns from customer interactions — common customization requests, recurring knowledge gaps, support themes — and feed structured, actionable intelligence back to curriculum owners on a regular cadence
Voice of Partner: Gather ongoing feedback, training requests, and operational insights from regional partners and field stakeholders, synthesizing this intelligence into quarterly "Voice of the Japan and Korea Partner" reports to directly inform GRE strategies, align cross-functional priorities, and shape global content roadmaps.
Expansion Signal: Identify and flag education-adjacent indicators of upsell or expansion opportunity; translate high support volume, out-of-scope training requests, or onboarding bottlenecks into account intelligence for the broader GTM team
Sales Motion Integration: Build credibility with Japan and Korea field teams as a trusted resource; position education as part of the core account strategy rather than a transactional add-on
Program Delivery & Management: Scale and execute global partner enablement initiatives by managing regional delivery cadences, maintaining central scheduling visibility, and leading strategic program pilots to evaluate performance metrics and refine broad rollout strategies.
Regional Coverage: Be the cornerstone of GRE in both Japan and Korea

You know how enterprise Japan works. You've sold, enabled, or partnered with large Japanese enterprises and you understand what it takes to build trust in this market. You know the difference between a warm relationship and a productive one, and you know how to move between them. You're not learning Japan on this job — you're applying what you already know.
You're fluent in the language and the culture. Business-level Japanese is a hard requirement. You can run an executive conversation, navigate a difficult objection, and build rapport with a customer champion — all without a translator in the room. Korean fluency is a strong plus as the Korea book grows.
You connect education to outcomes, not activity. You're not here to deliver training hours. You care whether customers actually use what they learn, whether that translates to consumption, and whether the account team sees you as a strategic resource. You track the right things and you can make the case for education in commercial terms.
You operate independently. You'll be the primary Customer Activation presence in Japan and the lead for Korea, with a manager based regionally but not locally. You're energized by that ownership, not unsettled by it. You know when to escalate and when to just figure it out.
You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. Your success depends on how well you work with account executives, SEs, CSMs, and delivery teams — many of whom will be skeptical of education's role in the account motion until you show them otherwise. You bring patience, credibility, and persistence to that work.
You understand channel dynamics. You're not here to run generic workshops. You care whether GSIs, RSIs, and Resellers build true delivery capability, whether that drives regional pipeline and consumption, and whether partners view you as an indispensable strategic asset. You know how each partner type operates, and you can translate enablement into measurable business growth.

Required
7+ years of experience in customer success, channel enablement, sales, revenue enablement, or a related customer-facing role in enterprise software or cloud technology
Business-level Japanese fluency (spoken and written) — required
Demonstrated experience working directly with enterprise accounts in Japan, including navigating complex stakeholder environments
Strong commercial instincts — able to connect education investment to consumption, retention, or expansion outcomes
Experience operating independently across a large or geographically dispersed territory
Excellent communication skills in English; ability to bridge effectively between local customer needs and a globally distributed enablement team

Korean language proficiency (conversational or business-level)
Experience at a data platform, analytics, or cloud infrastructure company; familiarity with Snowflake's product ecosystem

About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

As an Out-of-Home Manager, you will lead strategic OOH planning and buying across traditional and digital formats. You will manage campaigns from briefing through recommendation, negotiation, production, posting, measurement, and reconciliation, while serving as a key partner to clients, media owners, and internal teams.

Develop OOH strategies based on client objectives, audiences, markets, locations, and the right mix of traditional and digital formats.
Lead market research, inventory evaluation, RFPs, proposal analysis, and media-owner negotiations.
Prepare clear recommendations, contracts, budgets, flowcharts, posting instructions, timelines, and creative specifications.
Manage campaigns through production, installation, posting, proof-of-performance, maintenance, and completion.
Partner with clients, planning teams, media owners, production vendors, creative agencies, finance, and analytics to deliver campaigns on strategy, on budget, and on time.
Monitor campaign delivery, resolve posting, production, quality, and billing issues, and maintain accurate financial records.
Review OOH creative for legibility, scale, viewing environment, and format requirements.
Present recommendations and campaign results, maintain strong partner relationships, and stay current on OOH market opportunities.
Manage workflow, review team output, mentor junior staff, and serve as an escalation point.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
At least 3 years of experience in OOH planning, buying, investment, or activation.
Strong knowledge of traditional and digital OOH formats, media owners, market research, location strategy, production, and measurement.
Experience managing multi-market plans, RFPs, negotiations, budgets, campaign execution, billing, and reconciliation.
Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with OOH planning and mapping tools is preferred.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems proactively, and coach junior team members.

3101 - SEO Account Manager - UK

Google has consolidated its media agency partnership into WPP Media, building on the world class digital work that EssenceMediacom has delivered for Google for over 15 years. Media Futures Group (MFG) is a bespoke team that delivers on our commitment to Google for a more strategic, creative and integrated media approach established to drive better business results.
The MFG team is made up of best in class digital, offline, and integrated media experts who work together to enhance media’s contribution to Google’s business. MFG is powered by EssenceMediacom, and other constituents of WPP Media worldwide.

The MFG team operates in a seamlessly integrated way across strategy, planning, investment, creative, business sciences and analytics, data and technology. The profile of people who work in MFG are world class, committed to establishing a new high water mark in the media industry.
EssenceMediacom is seeking a talented SEO Account Manager to join our Organic Performance team in London. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the daily execution of the Google organic search strategy in EMEA across multiple Google products such as Google Ads, Gemini, Pixel, etc. Your main objective will be to ensure that Google's websites are optimised for search engines, user experience, and conversion rates.
You will be the primary point of contact for clients and responsible for day-to-day communication, ensuring the strategy is being deployed and implemented efficiently. You will work closely with Senior Executives and SEO Directors to deliver best-in-class SEO recommendations and drive results. We are looking for someone who is passionate about organic search, has strong data analysis and problem-solving skills, is a team player, and always eager to learn and grow.
Client-facing experience is essential as the role involves frequent interaction with clients, explaining recommendations, and reporting on performance. In addition, understanding of PPC and recent developments in this area is highly desirable as collaboration with the Paid Search team through Integrated Search will be part of this role.

You will be part of the Organic Performance team, which helps clients improve performance and user experience across their digital assets via organic (non-paid) channels like organic search (SEO), content optimisation, GEO, and integrated search.

Our team comprises experts who specialise in a range of disciplines within Organic Performance, some of whom have been in the team for 10 years. With such an experienced team working with you day to day, you will receive plenty of opportunities to learn and upskill yourself outside of your direct remit.
Our team spends a lot of time and effort driving innovation, particularly with the creation of custom dashboards and leveraging AI tools in our day-to-day. We encourage everyone in our team to take part in such initiatives. We are an open, friendly team who will encourage you to grow, develop your skills, and progress your career. Join us today and be part of a team that values growth, innovation, and collaboration!

Full responsibility of the project’s performance from start to finish

Organise and coordinate communication between clients and internal teams to ensure efficient and integrated ways of working

Perform technical SEO audits, identify issues and recommend fixes as well as following up with a review of the implementation
Assisting with site migrations (pre and post launch)
Integration with PPC to create synergy in Search
Monitor and report on campaign performance
Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analysing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact.
Quickly generates solutions informed by previous experience and understands how to resolve escalated issues..
Develop case studies throughout the course of the year
Coach and train junior members
Work with other members of the Organic Performance team to develop knowledge and understanding of Organic Search, Content Marketing, etc.

SEO experience in a digital media agency
A proven track record in delivering high performance SEO strategies
Knowledge of SEO practices and latest industry updates
Proficiency with audience research and SEO tools (Keyword Planner, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, SEMRush, Ahrefs, etc.)
Strong understanding and knowledge of content optimisation and Technical SEO (international SEO and site migration experience desirable)
Well organised and highly structured individual, with flawless project management skills
Show initiative and proactivity
Great analytical skills, proven critical thinking capability and attention to detail
Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal, written and slides/visual format
Self-starter who can proactively influence clients to help evolve best practices and drive innovation
Experience in internal and external stakeholder relationship management
Good understanding of paid media (i.e. PPC/Social/Display)

Act as the day-to-day point of contact for clients and internal teams, ensuring clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Receive, interpret and translate client briefs into clear, actionable briefs for internal teams, ensuring project objectives and requirements are fully understood.

Handle all aspects of client campaigns from planning through to final delivery, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Highlight and escalate quality control issues, risks or project concerns in a timely manner.
Work across multiple platforms and systems as part of day-to-day project management and workflow processes.
Support continuous improvement of operational processes, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and collaboration across teams.

Confident in leading client conversations and meetings, with the ability to converse clearly and manage expectations effectively.
Foundational production knowledge with the ability to support end-to-end campaign delivery in a fast-paced agency environment.
Excellent project management, prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients, projects, workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and quality.
Comfortable working additional hours during peak project periods to support client and business needs.
Experience working in a TV, creative, print or digital production role is essential.
Resilient and able to perform effectively under pressure while managing competing deadlines.
Fluent written and spoken English is essential; additional languages (Korean, Thai, Bahasa, Vietnamese, Chinese) are advantageous.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across clients and internal teams.
Experience managing and servicing international or regional accounts with multiple stakeholders is desirable.
Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of project scoping, agency profitability, budgeting and billing processes.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with the confidence and maturity to challenge constructively when appropriate.

Atolls is the world’s largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.
We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.
Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you’ll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

We are looking for an Account Manager (m/f/x) - Spanish Speaker to help our Commercial Team to develop our commercial efforts and build sustainable relationships with great brands and retailers there.
Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

· A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

· A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

· 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

· A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

· Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

· Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

· Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

· The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

· A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.
*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

s.t:
Identify potential partners, leading sales negotiations and closing them, onboarding and implementing additional business opportunities on the platform (Promodescuentos and couponation)
Build and maintain a strong, trusting business relationships by becoming the main point of contact and sparring partner for our partners
Develop a B2B2C strategy: advising partners and supporting their integration and growth on the platform
Monitor our partners' business results and implementing KPI-based optimizations
Collaborate with other departments (product team, design, marketing, etc.) as well as with colleagues from other countries

You have at least 1 year of experience in key account management and/or sales development
You speak Spanish at advance level and can hold conversations in English with confidence.
You are a talented communicator and you find it easy to build a professional network
CTRs, ROI, AOV plus other online advertising metrics and can present them convincingly to your partners.
Previous experience working with the Mexican market
You are available for work trips between 1 or 2 times per year
Affiliate marketing knowledge is a plus

We invite you to bring your experience and passion for partnering with large, complex cities and affiliated organizations, coupled with an understanding of applying geospatial technology to become an integral part of Esri’s State & Local Government team.

We’re looking for an individual who is customer oriented and a collaborative team player who enjoys identifying and implementing strategies that will radically improve the challenges organizations face.

You’ll work closely with a team that helps our new and existing major city and affiliated organizations optimize and expand adoption of Esri technology, identify new areas of growth, and deliver expertise that helps deliver on their mission.
At Esri, we are committed to our customers and their success. It is a place for you to do your best work and partner with our customers amid a supportive culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and passion.

Build relationships. Prospect, develop, and implement location strategies for large, complex organizations. Create new opportunities within high-level accounts and deepen relationships. Participate in and present at trade shows, workshops, and seminars.
Understand our customers. Demonstrate advanced industry knowledge and its relevance to the application of GIS. Identify key stakeholders and business drivers within organizations and gain access to executive, enterprise-level decision makers. Understand complex customer budgeting and acquisition processes.
Learn and grow. Clearly articulate the strength and value of Esri technology as it relates to the needs of major cities and affiliated organizations. Consistently conduct research and pursue professional development to ensure competitive knowledge. Use your innovative whiteboarding and presentation skills to support visual storytelling.
Deliver results. Proactively execute the account management and sales processes for all opportunities in order to meet revenue goals. Continually evaluate work in terms of its contribution to meeting customer needs.
Collaborate with others. Lead account strategies by consistently collaborating with teams across Esri and Esri business partners. Actively share knowledge and support/mentor team members. Be motivated and resourceful and take initiative to resolve issues.

5+ years of enterprise sales and/or relevant consulting or program management experience
Experience managing the sales cycle, creating partnerships, and establishing yourself as a trusted advisor with large customers
Possess financial and business acumen to build compelling account growth strategies
Advanced knowledge of large, complex government organizations and new technology trends and the ability to translate this into complex solutions for customers
Understanding of GIS, Esri technology, and enterprise government operations as they relate to one another
Expert visual storyteller and negotiator across all levels of an organization
Knowledge of industry fiscal year, budgeting, and procurement cycles
Ability to travel domestically or internationally 25-50%
Bachelor’s degree in GIS, business administration, or a related field
Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

General knowledge of data science or spatial analysis and how it is used for problem solving and uncovering patterns and trends within organizations
Master’s degree in GIS, business administration, or a related field
